definition: Sequences where words repeat to trace complementary patterns. The word must end on a variation of its start placement, eventually returning to the exact starting placement (home).

rotated.description: Placements rotate around the grid to return home
rotated.keyInsight: Rotated means COMPLETING the full rotation, not just reaching a rotated midpoint. The second half must CONTINUE rotating in the same direction to return home.

halved.pattern: Two halves, each rotates 180 degrees, completing 360 degrees total
halved.mentalModel: Like a clock hand moving continuously: starts at 12 o'clock, first half reaches 6 o'clock (180 degrees), second half CONTINUES to 12 o'clock (360 degrees). NOT going 0 to 180 then reversing back (that's Rewound).

quartered.pattern: Four quarters, each rotates 90 degrees, completing 360 degrees total
quartered.mentalModel: Clock hand: 12 to 3 to 6 to 9 to 12 (continuing same direction)

mirrored.description: Placements mirror vertically to return home
mirrored.effect: Left-right placements swap across the vertical midline

flipped.description: Placements mirror horizontally to return home
flipped.effect: Top-bottom placements swap across the horizontal midline
flipped.note: Same concept as mirrored but along perpendicular axis

swapped.description: Left and right hands swap roles
swapped.effect: What the left hand did, the right hand now does (and vice versa)

inverted.description: Motion types flip between PRO and ANTI
inverted.effect: Prospin becomes antispin, antispin becomes prospin

rewound.description: Second half plays in reverse - hands trace back
rewound.keyInsight: The hands retrace their path backwards to return home. Like pressing rewind on a video.
rewound.distinctionFromRotated: Rewound: Hands reverse direction to go back. Rotated: Hands continue same rotational direction forward.

sixteenCount.description: 4-letter word repeated 4 times, or 8-letter word repeated twice

type1Loops.focus: Letters moving between/within Alpha and Beta

gammaLoops.focus: Gamma to gamma letters connecting to other gamma to gamma letters
gammaLoops.rotatedPattern: Pictographs rotated 180 degrees in second repetition

type2Loops.focus: Using Type 2 letters to travel between alpha/beta and gamma

fullReversalLoops.complexity: Also include prop reversals within words

constructionPrinciples.wordEndingRequirement: Word must end on variation of start placement to enable seamless repetition
constructionPrinciples.homeReturn: Return to exact starting placement and orientation through calculated repetitions with transformations
constructionPrinciples.patternCompletion: Trace geometric or symmetric patterns in space for visual and kinesthetic satisfaction

freeform.description: Circular sequences that don't fit any recognizable LOOP pattern
freeform.note: Still returns to start, just not via standard transformations

AABB.note: NOT rotated - although placements at beat 2 are 180 degrees from start, the return happens via rewinding/mirroring, not continued rotation.

groupChoreography.potential: Dynamic and engaging when applied by multiple performers

applications.musicalIntegration: LOOP lengths often align with musical phrasing and repetition
